_comment: Template for make-samples.js. Copy to clients/<brand>.json. Concepts get written IN a Claude session (creative direction), Gabriel approves them BEFORE running this. Every URL must be the client's real asset (their domain or Shopify CDN) — the script enforces this.

concepts.name: people-with-taste
concepts.big_idea: Buying POCA isn't a diet choice, it's a taste signal — treat the sweetener like a status object, shot like a fragrance ad, not a grocery item.
concepts.image_prompt: Extreme macro top-down shot of a vibrant green iced matcha latte, the surface filled edge-to-edge with star-shaped ice cubes, glossy and luminous, rich texture, high contrast studio lighting, surreal and graphic, art-directed like a premium fragrance campaign. add no text or graphics

concepts.name: second-concept-here
concepts.big_idea: Write the actual idea here — what tension does the viewer feel, why do they stop scrolling, what does the image DO that a product photo cannot. Minimum 40 characters, enforced.
concepts.image_prompt: Describe a scene that expresses the idea. Banned: flat-lays, product-beside-beverage, marble counters, 'editorial product photography'. The script rejects those phrases.
